about.title: About me
about.text: Full-stack developer focused on Java, Angular, and React, building end-to-end applications with a priority on responsive interfaces and API integration. I focus on performance, usability, and best practices to create fluid, well-structured experiences. My transition from healthcare to technology brought distinct advantages in clear communication and empathy—essential for team collaboration.
